consequence.statement: Ingress path matching now uses Exact matching instead of ImplementationSpecific matching, which changes how request paths are matched against ingress rules.

assertion.statement: The Kubernetes Ingress pathType for cert-manager-managed ingresses changes from ImplementationSpecific to Exact.

proposal.undeterminedReason: applicability: evidence does not specify which cert-manager resources create Ingresses or under what configuration conditions this pathType change applies; the scope of affected ingress resources is not documented
